- Rollback: we have an automated rollback triggered by an SLA breach (latency or error-rate thresholds). If the override causes a P95 latency increase > 150ms or error-rate > 0.5% for 5 consecutive minutes, the control-plane will revert the override automatically. We'll also watch manually.

Deploy notes (technical):
- The change touches allocator flags and the async compaction trigger. No model weights are changed.
